Tang Dynasty Money, Currency, Kai Yuan Tong Bao
s: Kai Yuan Tong Bao is a kind of coin circulated during the Tang Dynasty (618 - 907). Kai Yuan means the opening of a new epoch and Tong Bao is the treasure in circulation. Kai Yuan Tong Bao is also known as Kai Tong Yuan Bao. The former was read up and down and from right to left while the latter was read clockwise from 12o'clock.
